units.headline: New test: stale counter decremented only when stale series evicted
units.summary: New test that checks numStaleSeries stays in sync when CompactSelectedSeries evicts a mix of stale and non-stale series. It only adds coverage and cannot change production behavior.
units.reason: New test only; adds coverage without altering production code.

units.headline: Exported StaleHead type renamed to SelectedSeriesHead
units.summary: The exported StaleHead type is renamed and generalized to hold any list of series refs. External importers of the tsdb package (e.g. Mimir, Cortex) that use StaleHead will no longer compile.
focus: Downstream users of exported StaleHead type break at compile time
units.reason: Renames an exported type, which breaks the public Go API.

units.headline: NewStaleHead renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead with generic refs
units.summary: The exported constructor is renamed and now takes seriesRefs instead of staleSeriesRefs. External callers of NewStaleHead break.
units.reason: Renames an exported constructor, which breaks the public API.

units.headline: Index delegates to renamed selectedSeriesIndex
units.summary: Mechanical rename: Index now calls the renamed selectedSeriesIndex helper with the same arguments, so the logic is equivalent.
units.reason: Same delegation as before, only the names changed.

units.headline: NumSeries now counts selected refs, not head stale count
units.summary: NumSeries now returns the number of selected refs instead of the head-wide stale-series count. That number flows into BlockMeta.Stats.NumSeries for the view, including stale compactions.
focus: Block stats / compactor consumers of view Meta().Stats.NumSeries
units.reason: Changes the value reported in block metadata stats.

units.headline: Placeholder ULID for the view renamed and given new value
units.summary: The placeholder ULID used in the view's in-memory meta is renamed and its value changed. It only identifies the view in memory or logs.
units.reason: Placeholder identifier for an in-memory view; low risk.

units.headline: Meta uses the renamed placeholder ULID
units.summary: Meta is the same as before except for the receiver type and the ULID constant name. The NumSeries value change is covered in its own unit.
units.reason: Mechanical rename inside an otherwise unchanged method.

units.headline: String output now says 'selected-series head'
units.summary: Only the human-readable string used in errors and logs changes.
units.reason: Only log/error text changed.
